title: Noun の 間に (〜no aida ni)
shortExplanation: Expresses 'while' or 'during' a specific period or time.
longExplanation: The Noun の 間に grammar point is used to indicate a specific period or time during which an action takes place. It is often translated as 'while' or 'during' in English. This grammar point requires a noun to represent the time or period.

examples.jp: 昼休みの間に銀行に行きます。
examples.romaji: Hiruyasumi no aida ni ginkou ni ikimasu.
examples.en: I will go to the bank during lunch break.

examples.jp: 夏休みの間に海外旅行に行く予定です。
examples.romaji: Natsuyasumi no aida ni kaigai ryokou ni iku yotei desu.
examples.en: I plan to go on an overseas trip during the summer vacation.

examples.jp: 子供たちが学校の間に買い物に行きました。
examples.romaji: Kodomo-tachi ga gakkou no aida ni kaimono ni ikimashita.
examples.en: I went shopping while the kids were at school.

examples.jp: 母の日にお母さんにプレゼントを送りました。
examples.romaji: Haha no hi ni okaasan ni purezento o okurimashita.
examples.en: I sent a gift to my mother on Mother’s Day.
